prediction_timestamp: after final grid confirmation and before race start

targets.points_finish: 1 when official race-result points are greater than zero
targets.podium_finish: 1 when official numeric finishing position is 1, 2, or 3
targets.race_winner: 1 when official numeric finishing position is 1
targets.finish_order: Official display order re-ranked contiguously within drivers eligible at the prediction timestamp; lower is better and DNF/DSQ/NC remain ranked.

outcome_metadata.classified_finish_position: Nullable official numeric classification; diagnostic only because DNF/DNS/DNP records can be unclassified.
outcome_metadata.result_status: Official result status such as a position, DNF, DNS, DNP, DSQ, or NC.
outcome_metadata.prediction_eligible: 1 only when the driver belonged to the field at the prediction timestamp.
outcome_metadata.eligibility_reason: Documented basis for the eligibility decision.
outcome_metadata.eligibility_source: F1DB grid source or external contemporaneous evidence URL.

eligibility_policy: Missing final-grid data is never itself evidence of ineligibility; every missing record requires an explicit timestamp-based audit decision.

preprocessing_contract.missing_value_policy: imputers must be fit on train only
